seo.title: Pricing: honest prices, published up front | Alliance AI Partners
seo.description: Starting prices for every core service, a fixed quote before work starts, no per-seat fees on the tools we build and AI usage passed on at cost. See how Alliance AI Partners prices AI work.

content.heading: Honest prices, published up front.
content.lead: Every core service has a starting price on this page. Before work starts, you get a fixed quote that lists everything we will charge, and any change is quoted before we do it.

images.source: Editorial illustration on a calm Daylight background. One continuous satin ribbon, shading from Alliance Blue at the left to Ribbon Cyan at the right, runs in a gentle, slightly sagging line from the upper left toward the right edge, like a line strung across a bright room. From it hang five blank tags made of flat faceted paper, in pale Daylight white, soft blue-grey and Partner Navy, each tied on with a short loop of the same ribbon. Every tag is turned to face the viewer, flat and fully visible, none twisted or turned away: prices shown openly, nothing hidden. The tags differ a little in size and hang at even intervals, the largest just right of centre. Soft navy-tinted shadows fall down and to the right onto the pale ground behind them. Keep the lower left third calm and empty. Aspect about 1.08:1, safe to crop to 4:5 for mobile. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.

content.heading: Seven promises you can check.
content.lead: Honest pricing has to mean something you can test. Here is what we promise, and where you will see each promise in writing.

items.text: Published starting prices for every core service.
A fixed quote before work starts that lists everything we’ll charge. Changes are quoted before we do them.
If an off-the-shelf tool or a simpler fix costs you less, we say so.
No per-seat fees on the tools we build.
AI usage, like model fees, passed on at cost and shown on the invoice.
Monthly plans you can cancel with [30] days’ notice.

sections.name: Starting prices
sections.job: Publish the starting price of each core service and say what it includes.

Cards stretch to one height.
sections.mobile: Head stacked; the four cards in one column, AI check-up first with its price well and all five included items; on the other three cards the mono price and its caption move under the title, then the includes line below a hairline and a small link.

content.heading: What it costs to start.
content.lead: Starting prices for our four core services, and what each one includes. Your fixed quote confirms the price before any work starts.

items.title: AI check-up
items.text: Our usual first project. In [two weeks], we find where AI could save you time or money. Includes: interviews with your team and a walk through your tools; your slowest processes, followed from start to finish; a written plan, ranked by what each fix would save; a fixed quote for the first fix; honest advice when AI is not the answer.

items.title: Websites and web apps
items.text: Custom websites and web apps, with AI built in where it helps. Includes: design, build and launch; project management, testing and documentation; you own the code.

items.title: AI automation projects
items.text: We connect your software and hand repetitive tasks to AI. Includes: a map of the work, signed off before we build; tested with your real data, reviewed by a person; AI usage passed on at cost.

items.title: Embedded developers
items.text: A developer from our team joins yours full time. Includes: recruiting, salary, benefits and equipment; cancel with [30] days’ notice.

content.heading: How other AI firms charge, and what we do instead.
content.lead: Published examples of the usual ways AI work is priced, what to watch for in each, and how we price the same work.

rows: By the hour
Most US and Australian web development agencies charge US$100 to US$149 an hour. [1]
Slow work costs more, and the final bill is hard to predict.
A fixed quote for each project
Per seat
Microsoft 365 Copilot is US$30 per user a month, paid yearly, on top of a Microsoft 365 plan. For 50 people, that’s US$1,500 a month. [2]
Costs rise with every person you add.
No per-seat fees on tools we build, and honest advice on which seats you need
Per resolution or per call
Intercom’s Fin is US$0.99 per outcome, with seats extra. [3] Smith.ai’s AI receptionist is US$150 a month for 75 calls, then US$2.50 a call. [4]
Busy months cost more, so budgets are hard to set.
[A flat monthly price, with AI usage passed on at cost]
Monthly retainer
SEO retainers on Clutch run from US$2,000 to US$20,000 a month, averaging US$3,199. [5]
It isn’t always clear what the retainer buys.
A retainer that lists the work it covers
No published prices
Some firms share prices only after a sales call.
You can’t compare until you’ve given up an hour.
Published starting prices

body: These are examples of how AI is priced, not attacks on these companies. Some of these tools are the right choice for a partner, and our AI assistant rollout service sets them up.

content.heading: Questions about price
content.lead: Straight answers to what partners ask before they sign.

faq.q: Why do you cost less than most AI firms?
faq.a: Two reasons. AI does the repetitive work, so a project needs fewer billable hours. And our team is based in the Philippines, so our costs are lower than those of firms in the US, the UK or Australia. We pass the difference on to you.
No. AI takes over the repetitive hours, and a person still reviews every piece of work before it reaches you.

faq.q: What does a starting price include?
faq.a: Project management, testing and documentation. Your fixed quote lists everything else before we start.

faq.q: What if the work changes after we start?
faq.a: We quote the change before we do it. Nothing reaches your invoice that you did not agree to first.
At cost, with no markup, on its own line of your invoice, with the usage report attached.

faq.q: Can we cancel a monthly plan?
faq.a: Yes. Monthly plans run month to month, and you can cancel with [30] days’ notice. You keep what we built.

faq.q: Will you tell us if a ready-made tool would cost less?
faq.a: Yes, even when it means less work for us. Our AI assistant rollout service sets it up for you.
